title: Suspicious Email Report
briefing: Several employees report receiving an email asking them to urgently reset their corporate passwords using a provided link.
options: Ask employees to follow the reset link
Escalate the email to the security team
answer: Escalate the email to the security team

feedback.Ignore the reports: Incorrect. Ignoring multiple user reports can allow a phishing campaign to continue spreading inside the organization.
feedback.Ask employees to follow the reset link: Dangerous. The link may lead to a credential harvesting site designed to steal user passwords.
feedback.Escalate the email to the security team: Correct. Escalation allows security teams to analyze the email, block malicious domains, and warn other users.
